    Meal details and definitions

    All 8,000 meal records are included with equal weights. Thermic-effect share = total thermic-effect calories / total calories; calories per item = total calories / total food items. The highest activity band uses the source labels Extreme / Half-Marathon Toll; the other three bands are grouped together. Exercise duration uses source estimates. Footer totals sum meal counts; meal-group means are not added.
